_note: Hand-derived from docs/PRD.md rules. status=draft until replayed in Stripe test mode; then status=verified. Amounts in minor units (JPY: major).

SAVE20 once
SAVE20 applied twice right after subscribing discounts the next invoice once
scenarios.math: Stripe finalizes the first invoice when the subscription is created, so a coupon applied at the same instant (twice: a reload) discounts the next invoice exactly once. Corrected after the Stripe test-clock replay contradicted the hand derivation.

scenarios.title: Downgrade with always_invoice creates a credit balance
scenarios.math: remaining 15/31: -round(7900*15/31)=-3823, +round(2900*15/31)=1403 -> total -2420, amount_due 0, balance -2420; next invoice 2900 - 2420 = 480 due

scenarios.title: Upgrade under a forever 25% coupon: prorations are pre-discounted, not re-discounted
scenarios.math: proration uses the discounted price: -round(2900*0.75*15/31)=-1052, +round(7900*0.75*15/31)=2867; proration lines are not discountable, so the coupon only hits 7900: round(7900*0.25)=1975; total -1052+2867+7900-1975=7740

scenarios.title: Migration $29 -> $39, no grandfathering
Same migration, grandfathered
Annual price migration reports MRR per customer
scenarios.math: annual MRR = round(unit_amount*seats/12) per customer: acme 4833 -> 6500, globex 2417 -> 3250; totals 7250 -> 9750

scenarios.title: Seat increase after a used-up 'once' coupon: the credit refunds the discounted price actually paid
scenarios.math: March was charged 3600-20%=2880. Credit 21/31 of what was paid: -round(3600*0.8*21/31)=-1951. The coupon is used up, so the 5 seats are full price: +round(6000*21/31)=4065; renewal 6000; total 8114

scenarios.title: Changing the price without a quantity resets 5 seats to quantity 1 (Stripe item semantics)
scenarios.math: 12 of 31 days left. Credit -round(6000*12/31)=-2323; pro_m x1: +round(7900*12/31)=3058; renewal 7900; total 8635

scenarios.title: Changing the price with quantity 5 keeps all 5 seats
Two seat changes in one period after a used-up 'once' coupon: each credit refunds the rate it was charged at
scenarios.math: First change as S30: -1951 (March was paid at 80%), +4065 (full price, coupon used up). Second change, 11/31 left: the 5 seats were charged at full price, so -round(6000*11/31)=-2129, +round(8400*11/31)=2981; renewal 8400; total 11366. Stripe corrected our first derivation (-1703, credit at March's 80%).

scenarios.title: Coupon applied mid-period, then an upgrade: January was paid in full, so its credit is full price
scenarios.math: Credit what January cost: -round(2900*15/31)=-1403; the coupon is active now: +round(7900*0.75*15/31)=2867; renewal 7900 less 25% = 1975; total -1403+2867+7900-1975=7389

scenarios.title: A period made free by an amount_off coupon refunds nothing when it is changed
scenarios.math: March: 4800, $50 off capped at 4800, paid 0. Interval change invoices now: credit -round((4800-4800)*15/31)=0; pro_y 29000; FIFTYOFF is used up; total 29000

scenarios.title: Seat increase under a repeating amount_off coupon: both proration lines are net of the $10
A once coupon applied mid-period is used up by the proration it prices
scenarios.math: January was paid in full: credit -round(7900*12/31)=-3058. Charge priced with SAVE20: round(15800*12/31)-round(3160*12/31)=6116-1223=4893, which uses SAVE20 up, so the 15800 renewal is not discounted: total 17635

scenarios.title: Changing to the same quantity or the same price is a no-op
scenarios.math: Nothing changes, so no prorations and the quantity stays 2 (R13 resets only for a different price): 15800 each month

scenarios.title: Cancel at period end bills pending prorations on a final invoice, with negative tax
scenarios.math: Downgrade with 15/31 left: -round(7900*15/31)=-3823, +round(2900*15/31)=1403. No renewal on 02-01, but a final invoice: subtotal -2420, exclusive tax round(-2420*10%)=-242, total -2662, amount due 0 (credit)

scenarios.title: always_invoice change at the exact renewal instant: separate invoices, the credit pays the renewal
scenarios.math: 02-01 renews 2 seats (15800, a draft). The change then covers the whole new period: -15800 +7900 = -7900, invoiced and finalized first (amount due 0). The renewal finalizes after it and uses the 7900 credit: amount due 7900

scenarios.title: Switching to a yearly price during a trial issues a new $0 trial invoice
scenarios.math: Trial invoice 0 at start; the interval switch issues another 0 trial invoice; the trial ends 01-15 and bills pro_y 29000

scenarios.title: Proration charge under a percent coupon is rounded in two steps
A no-op change with always_invoice still invoices earlier pending prorations now
scenarios.math: 01-10, 22/31 left: -round(2400*22/31)=-1703, +round(7200*22/31)=5110, pending. 01-20 changes nothing, but always_invoice invoices the pending lines now: 3407. Renewal 02-01: 7200

scenarios.title: proration_behavior none: no lines now; a later proration credits the item as it is then, not what was paid
scenarios.math: 01-10 switches pro_m -> starter_m without prorating (the $79 paid is not credited). 01-20, 12/31 left: credit the current item -round(2900*12/31)=-1123, charge +round(8700*12/31)=3368, pending. 02-01: -1123+3368+8700=10945. 03-01: 8700

scenarios.title: Ending a trial early bills the first period now, resets the anchor, and the once coupon applies to it
scenarios.math: Trial invoice $0 (the once coupon is not used on $0). 01-03 trial_end=now: 7900-20%=6320 +10% tax 632 = 6952, anchor day 3. 02-03 and 03-03: 7900+790=8690

scenarios.title: Immediate cancel: no final invoice and pending prorations are dropped; a new subscription starts clean
scenarios.math: 01-10 prorations (-5606, +16819) stay pending; 01-20 cancel now (Stripe default invoice_now=false, prorate=false) never invoices them. 02-01 new subscription 2900; 03-01 2900

scenarios.title: Undoing a scheduled cancel keeps renewing
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900-1580=6320. Cancel scheduled 01-05, undone 01-10, so 02-01 and 03-01 renew at 7900 (the once coupon is spent)

scenarios.title: Interval change with proration_behavior none: invoices the new interval now without a credit
scenarios.math: Month -> year still resets the anchor and invoices now, but with none there is no unused-time credit: 29000. Next renewal 2028-01-15

scenarios.title: After a none change, an always_invoice change credits the current quantity at the coupon rate
A repeating coupon lasts its months in calendar time, not a count of invoices (yearly -> monthly)
scenarios.math: TENOFF3 ($10 off, 3 months) applied 01-25 ends 04-25. 01-25: 29000-1000=28000. 02-05 month interval, 354/365 of the year left: credit -round(28000*354/365)=-27156, +7900 discounted 1000: total -20256 (credit). 03-05: 6900, balance -20256 -> due 0. 04-05 is before 04-25, still discounted: 6900, due 0, balance -6456. 05-05: coupon over, 7900, due 7900-6456=1444. Counting invoices would have stopped the discount after 03-05.

scenarios.title: Reset the billing anchor mid-period (billing_cycle_anchor=now): credit unused time, bill a full new period today
scenarios.math: 01-01: 2 x 7900 = 15800. 01-11 anchor reset, 21/31 of January left: credit -round(15800*21/31) = -10703, plus a full period 15800: total 5097. The anchor is now the 11th: 02-11 and 03-11 renew at 15800.

scenarios.title: Anchor reset with proration none still sweeps earlier pending prorations into the invoice, without a credit
Removing a forever coupon: later invoices are full price, but the next credit refunds what was paid (discounted)
Two interval changes under an amount-off coupon: the second credit refunds the discounted yearly charge
A half-cent tie that is not a tie: Stripe prorates the unit price to 12 decimals before multiplying by seats (found by fuzzing)
The same 12-decimal unit proration on a single seat: 7900 x 19/30 x 75% credits 3752, not 3753
A coupon applied at the exact renewal instant discounts the next invoice, not that renewal (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 01-01: 3 x 1200 = 3600. 02-01: the renewal draft is created at 00:00 with no discount; TENOFF3 applied in that same second only reaches later invoices: 3600. 02-15 qty 2, 14/28 left: credit what was paid, -round(3600*14/28) = -1800 (not -1300); charge round(2400*14/28) = 1200 - round(1000*14/28) = 500 -> 700. 03-01: 2400 - 1000 + 700 - 1800 = 300.

scenarios.title: Flexible: two interval changes keep the anchor and credit each original debit (no invoice until the monthly renewal)
scenarios.math: Flexible keeps the 01-01 anchor. 01-01: 7900-1000 = 6900. 01-16 yearly: the yearly period aligned to the anchor is 2026-01-01 -> 2027-01-01 (365 d, 350 left). Credit the January debit, gross and discount apart over 16/31: -(round(7900*16/31)=4077 - round(1000*16/31)=516) = -3561. Debit round(29000*350/365)=27808 - round(1000*350/365)=959 = 26849. Pending, and no 02-01 invoice (the item is yearly now). 02-10 monthly: period 02-01 -> 03-01 (28 d, 19 left). Credit the 26849 debit over its own span 01-16 -> 2027-01-01 (350 d, 325 left): -round(26849*325/350) = -24931. Debit round(7900*19/28)=5361 - round(1000*19/28)=679 = 4682. 03-01: pending + 7900, TENOFF3 live until 04-01: subtotal 10939, discount 1000, total 9939. 04-01: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: a metered subscription gets no $0 invoice at creation
scenarios.math: Flexible suppresses the zero-amount metered line at creation, and an empty invoice is not created. 02-01: tiers 1000 x 0 = 0, 9000 x 1 = 9000, 2346 x 0.5 = 1173: total 10173.

scenarios.title: Flexible: a price change during a trial issues a new $0 trial invoice right away
scenarios.math: Trial 01-01 -> 01-15: $0. Flexible bills a change during a trial like any change, so 01-05 gets its own $0 trial invoice. 01-15: 7900. 02-15: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: billing_cycle_anchor=now nets the overlap and debits only the time past the old period end
scenarios.math: 01-01: 15800. 01-11 reset: new period 01-11 -> 02-11 (31 d). 01-11 -> 02-01 was already paid, so its credit and debit cancel; only 02-01 -> 02-11 is debited: round(15800*10/31) = 5097, pending (no invoice now). 02-11: 5097 + 15800 = 20897. 03-11: 15800.

scenarios.title: Flexible: credits round gross and discount apart; an anchor reset with none debits nothing, so nothing is credited later
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900 - 1580 = 6320. 01-11 x3 (21/31 left): credit -(round(7900*21/31)=5352 - round(1580*21/31)=1070) = -4282 (one-step on 6320 would be -4281); debit round(23700*21/31) = 16055 (SAVE20 used up), pending. 01-21 reset with none: anchor moves to the 21st, nothing is billed, so 02-01 -> 02-21 is never debited. 02-10 x1 (period 01-21 -> 02-21, 11 left): no debit covers it, so no credit; debit round(7900*11/31) = 2803. 02-21: -4282 + 16055 + 2803 + 7900 = 22476. 03-21: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: the credit's gross and discount are each rounded from the 12-decimal prorated unit price
Flexible: after a none change, the next proration credits what was originally debited, not the item as it is
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900. 01-10 starter_m with none: nothing billed; the pro_m debit still covers January. 01-20 x3 (12/31 left): credit the pro_m debit -round(7900*12/31) = -3058 (classic credits starter_m: -1123); debit round(8700*12/31) = 3368. 02-01: -3058 + 3368 + 8700 = 9010. 03-01: 8700.

scenarios.title: Flexible: always_invoice after a none change credits the original 2-seat debit at its coupon
scenarios.math: 01-01: 15800 - 3950 = 11850. 01-10 x1 with none: nothing billed. 01-20 x4 always_invoice (12/31 left): credit the 2-seat debit -(round(15800*12/31)=6116 - round(3950*12/31)=1529) = -4587 (classic credits 1 seat: -2294); debit round(31600*12/31)=12232 - round(7900*12/31)=3058 = 9174. Invoiced now: 4587 (prorations are not discounted again). 02-01 and 03-01: 31600 - 7900 = 23700.

scenarios.title: Flexible: a proration debit is credited from its rounded gross and rounded discount, not its net (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 02-29: 2900 - 725 = 2175, period 02-29 -> 03-29. 03-27 reset: new period 03-27 -> 04-27 (31 d); only 03-29 -> 04-27 (29 d) is debited: round(2900*29/31)=2713 - round(725*29/31)=678 = 2035, pending. 04-17 x3, 10 of 31 days left: credit the 2035 debit over 10 of its 29 days, -(round(2713*10/29)=936 - round(678*10/29)=234) = -702; debit round(8700*10/31)=2806 - round(2175*10/31)=702 = 2104. 04-23 pro_y always_invoice: the yearly period aligned to the 03-27 anchor is 2028-03-27 -> 2029-03-27 (365 d, 338 left). Credit the 2104 debit over 4 of its 10 days from its parts: -(round(2806*0.4)=1122 - round(702*0.4)=281) = -841 (round(2104*0.4) would be -842). Debit round(29000*338/365)=26855 - round(7250*338/365)=6714 = 20141. Invoiced now with the pending lines: 2035 - 702 + 2104 - 841 + 20141 = 22737. No renewal before 2029.

scenarios.title: Cancel now with a refund (prorate + invoice_now): the final invoice carries pending prorations and the unused-time credit
scenarios.math: 01-01: 2 x 1200 = 2400. 01-05 x5, 27/31 left: credit -round(2400*27/31) = -2090, debit round(6000*27/31) = 5226, pending. 01-20 cancel with prorate + invoice_now, 12/31 left: classic credits the item as it is at the rate last charged, -round(6000*12/31) = -2323. Final invoice now with the pending lines: -2090 + 5226 - 2323 = 813. No later invoices.

scenarios.title: Flexible: cancelling a taxed yearly plan with a refund creates a credit balance that pays the next subscription
scenarios.math: 01-01: 29000 + 10% = 31900. 04-10 cancel with prorate + invoice_now: 266 of 365 days left; credit the original debit -round(29000*266/365) = -21134, tax -round(2113.4) = -2113 (R6): total -23247, which becomes credit balance (R10). 05-01 new pro_m subscription, no tax: 7900, starting balance -23247, amount due 0, balance -15347. 06-01: 7900, starting balance -15347, due 0.

scenarios.title: An amount due below Stripe's $0.50 minimum is not charged; it is carried onto the next invoice (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 04-30: 3 x 2900 = 8700, period 04-30 -> 05-30 (30 d). 05-09 team_seat_m x3, 21/30 left: credit -round(8700*21/30) = -6090, debit round(3600*21/30) = 2520, pending. 05-30: -6090 + 2520 + 3600 = 30, below Stripe's 50-cent minimum charge: amount due 0 and +30 is carried as a debit balance. 06-30: 3600, starting balance +30, amount due 3630.

scenarios.title: Flexible: after a none yearly -> monthly change, a later change credits the yearly debit only to the monthly period end (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: Yearly period 2027-01-10 -> 2028-01-10 (31536000 s). 01-10: 29000 - 5800 (SAVE20, once) = 23200 + 10% tax = 25520. 02-06 05:43:31 x8, f = 29182589/31536000: credit the original debit apart, -(round(29000f)=26836 - round(5800f)=5367) = -21469; debit 8 x 26835.840975393201 (12 places) = 214687, pending. 03-10 pro_m x4 with none: the monthly period aligned to the anchor is 03-10 -> 04-10; nothing billed. 03-25 18:30:17 pro_y x2 always_invoice: credit the 214687 debit only from now to the monthly period end 04-10, over its own span 02-06 05:43:31 -> 2028-01-10: -round(214687 * (04-10 - now)/(2028-01-10 - 02-06 05:43:31)) = -9680; debit 2 x pro_y to 2028-01-10 = 46119. Invoiced now with the pending lines: 229657, tax 22966, total 252623. Canceled at the 2028 period end, so no more invoices.

scenarios.title: cancel_at inside the current period: a final invoice on that date credits the unused time at the discounted rate
scenarios.math: 01-01: 15800 - 25% = 11850. 01-05 sets cancel_at 01-20 (create_prorations). 01-20: the subscription ends; 12/31 of January is unused: -round(11850*12/31) = -4587 on a final invoice, which becomes credit balance (amount due 0). No later invoices.

scenarios.title: Flexible: cancel_at in a later period cuts the last renewal short, priced as gross minus discount each rounded
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900 - 1975 = 5925. 01-05 sets cancel_at 02-15. 02-01 renewal covers only 02-01 -> 02-15, 14 of February's 28 days: round(7900*14/28) = 3950 - round(1975*14/28) = 988 (987.5 rounds up) = 2962 (one step on 5925 would give 2963); it is a proration line, so no invoice discount. Ends 02-15, nothing after.

scenarios.title: cancel_at sweeps pending prorations onto the final invoice with the credit for the seats as they are
scenarios.math: 01-01: 2400. 01-08 x6, 24/31 left: credit -round(2400*24/31) = -1858, debit round(7200*24/31) = 5574, pending. 01-25 the subscription ends: 7/31 left, credit the 6 seats -round(7200*7/31) = -1626. Final invoice: -1858 + 5574 - 1626 = 2090.

scenarios.title: Bill on a fixed day: billing_cycle_anchor at creation prorates the time until the first billing date over one interval from the start
scenarios.math: Start 02-10, anchor 03-05. The stub divides by one month counted from the start, 02-10 -> 03-10 (28 days, not 31). 23 days to the anchor: round(7900*23/28) = 6489, a proration. Then the anchor day: 03-05 and 04-05 at 7900.

scenarios.title: A once coupon is used up by the first-billing-date proration; the first full invoice is full price
scenarios.math: Anchor 07-01: yearly period 2026-07-01 -> 2027-07-01 (365 d), 172 days left on 01-10. Prorate with the coupon: round(29000*172/365) = 13666 - round(5800*172/365) = 2733 = 10933. SAVE20 (once) prices that charge, so it is used up: 07-01 bills 29000 with no discount.

scenarios.title: Flexible: an upgrade before the first billing date credits the stub debit over its own days
scenarios.math: Anchor 01-31: period 12-31 -> 01-31 (31 d). 01-20 stub: round(2900*11/31) = 1029. 01-25 pro_m: credit the 1029 debit over 6 of its 11 days, -round(1029*6/11) = -561; debit round(7900*6/31) = 1529, pending. 01-31: -561 + 1529 + 7900 = 8868. The anchor day 31 clamps to 02-28: 7900.

scenarios.title: First-billing-date stub is prorated over one interval counted from the start (05-31 -> 06-30), not the period ending on the anchor (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: Start 05-31: one month from it is 06-30 (June has 30 days), so the stub divides by 30, not by 05-13 -> 06-13's 31. 13 days to the anchor: round(23700*13/30) = 10270, inclusive VAT round(10270*20/120) = 1712. Then 06-13 and 07-13: 23700, VAT 3950.

scenarios.title: Flexible: a period made free by an amount_off coupon is still credited, as a $0 line (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 06-05: 4 x 1200 = 4800 less FIFTYOFF ($50 once, capped at 4800): 0. 06-28 pro_m x5 always_invoice, 7 of 30 days left: credit the debit gross and discount apart, round(4800*7/30) - round(4800*7/30) = 0, kept as a $0 line; debit round(39500*7/30) = 9217 (the once coupon is used). Invoiced now: 0 + 9217, inclusive VAT round(9217/6) = 1536. 07-05: 39500, VAT 6583.

scenarios.title: A percent coupon on a proration charge comes off the rounded gross: 28542 x 25% = 7135.5 -> 7136 (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 01-02 stub to the 01-21 anchor over 01-02 -> 02-02 (31 d), 19 days: gross round(2900*19/31) = 1777, 25% of it round(444.25) = 444: 1333 (VAT incl. 222). 01-16 anchor reset with none: a full period now, 2900 - 725 = 2175, no credit. Period 01-16 -> 02-16. 01-19 pro_m x4, 28 of 31 days left: credit what was paid, -round(2175*28/31) = -1965; charge gross round(31600*28/31) = 28542, discount 25% of 28542 = 7135.5 -> 7136 (not round(7900*28/31) = 7135): 21406. 02-16: -1965 + 21406 + 31600 = 51041, discount 7900, total 43141, VAT incl. round(43141/6) = 7190.

scenarios.title: Flexible: pause mid-period, resume a month later; the unused-time credit rides on the resumption invoice and the cycle restarts
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900, period 01-01 -> 02-01 (31 d). 01-16 pause (Stripe default: bill_for.unused_time_from now, invoicing_behavior pending_invoice_item): the period ends now; credit 16 of 31 days of the debit, -round(7900*16/31) = -4077, pending. No invoice on 02-01 (paused). 02-15 resume (billing_cycle_anchor now): new period 02-15 -> 03-15, invoiced at once with the pending credit: 7900 - 4077 = 3823. 03-15: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: resume with billing_cycle_anchor unchanged; nothing is invoiced at resume, the rest of the cycle is prorated onto the next renewal
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900. 01-16 pause: -4077 pending (16/31). 02-15 resume, anchor unchanged (01-01): the period containing 02-15 is 02-01 -> 03-01 (28 d); the 14 days left are charged round(7900*14/28) = 3950 as a pending proration, no invoice now. 03-01 renewal: -4077 + 3950 + 7900 = 7773. 04-01: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: pause with invoicing_behavior invoice; the credit is its own invoice and becomes customer balance
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900. 01-16 pause with always_invoice (Stripe invoicing_behavior invoice): a credit invoice now, total -4077, amount due 0, balance -4077 (R10). 02-15 resume: 7900, starting balance -4077, amount due 3823. 03-15: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: pause without crediting unused time (bill_for.unused_time_from none)
scenarios.math: 01-01: 7900. 01-16 pause with none (Stripe bill_for.unused_time_from none): no credit. 02-15 resume: a full 7900 for 02-15 -> 03-15. 03-15: 7900.

scenarios.title: Flexible: pausing a discounted, multi-seat subscription mid-day credits gross and discount rounded apart
scenarios.math: 01-01: 3 x 7900 = 23700 less 25% = 5925, total 17775. 01-20 12:00 pause: 11.5 of 31 days unused; credit -(round(23700*11.5/31) = 8792 - round(5925*11.5/31) = 2198) = -6594, pending (Stripe: 'Unused time on 3 x pro_m (with 25.0% off)'). 01-25 resume: new period 01-25 -> 02-25; 23700 - 6594 = 17106 subtotal, the coupon discounts only the new period line: 5925, total 11181. 02-25: 17775.

scenarios.title: Flexible: a first-billing-date stub divides by the anchor-aligned period ending on the anchor, not one interval from the start (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: Anchor 03-22: in flexible mode the stub divides by 02-22 -> 03-22 (29 days in leap 2028), where classic divides by one month from the start, 03-05 -> 04-05 (31, S77). 17 days to the anchor: gross round(6000*17/29) = 3517, 25% of the rounded gross 879.25 -> 879, charge 2638. 03-22: 6000 - 1500 = 4500. 04-22: 4500.

scenarios.title: Flexible: after an unprorated price change, resuming in the same period charges nothing for the rest of it (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 04-03: 2900, period 04-03 -> 05-03 (30 d). 04-14 team_seat_m with none: nothing billed; the 2900 debit stays (R16). 04-28 pause: credit that debit for 5 of 30 days, -round(2900*5/30) = -483, pending. 04-29 resume with the anchor unchanged: the period is still 04-03 -> 05-03, the one the unprorated change was made in, and Stripe charges nothing for the 4 days left (probes Q1 and Q5, any new price). 05-03: -483 + 1200 = 717. 06-03: 1200.

scenarios.title: Flexible: after an unprorated change, resuming in a later period charges the rest of that period as usual
scenarios.math: 04-03: 2900. 04-14 pro_m with none: nothing billed. 04-28 pause: -round(2900*5/30) = -483 pending. Paused through 05-03: no renewal. 05-20 resume, anchor unchanged: period 05-03 -> 06-03 (31 d), 14 days left: round(7900*14/31) = 3568, pending. 06-03: -483 + 3568 + 7900 = 10985.

scenarios.title: Flexible: the charge for resuming with an unchanged anchor takes a percent discount off the unrounded gross (found by fuzzing)
scenarios.math: 01-01: 5 x 2900 = 14500 less 25% = 3625, total 10875. 01-05 pause with none: no credit, no renewals while paused. 03-23 resume, anchor unchanged: period 03-01 -> 04-01 (31 d), 9 days left: gross 14500*9/31 = 4209.68 -> 4210; the discount is 25% of the unrounded gross, 1052.42 -> 1052 (25% of 4210 would be 1052.5 -> 1053, as a change's remaining-time charge does, S79): 3158, pending. 04-01: 3158 + 14500, coupon on the period line 3625, total 14033. 05-01: 10875.
